erpax.comment: The site is the connector: /api/mcp is @payloadcms/plugin-mcp, a gateway onto the same collections the REST API serves. The headers come from scripts/erpax.mjs at connect time: the token of the sign-in kept by `pnpm erpax login` for this origin (Payload is the OAuth server), or none, and then Claude Code offers its own OAuth sign-in; the signed-in user decides access and tenant scope. Set ERPAX_MCP_URL=http://localhost:3000/api/mcp to use a local server (pnpm erpax login --local). When the API cannot do a job, the agent records an emerging_gap memory (AGENTS.md, Agents work through Payload).
